title: Shadow of the First Choice | ECHO//100 Episode 62
description: Mira confronts the architect of the loop within a reconstructed childhood memory. Episode 62 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is an AI-assisted original fiction work.

scenes.text: The void shatters, replacing the expanse with the familiar, dusty floor of Kavi’s original childhood bedroom.
scenes.caption: Memory floor materializes
scenes.image_prompt: Mira in her teal coat standing on wooden floorboards in a messy 90s bedroom, Null's shadow stretching long.

scenes.text: Mira turns, but Null stands motionless, hand extended toward a glowing, antique phone resting on the bed.
scenes.caption: The beckoning hand
scenes.image_prompt: Null, a black-purple glitch figure with red eyes, gesturing toward a vintage phone on a bed.

scenes.text: A flicker of light reveals a younger Kavi picking up the dead phone, desperate to prevent loss.
scenes.caption: The forbidden call
scenes.image_prompt: Young Kavi in a red hoodie clutching an old rotary phone, surrounded by shimmering golden light.

scenes.text: That first desperate choice echoed through time, birthing the glitch entity from his own static-filled regret.
scenes.caption: Birth of the glitch
scenes.image_prompt: The young Kavi fading into purple digital dust, forming the silhouette of the Null entity.

scenes.text: Kavi-Byte watches the scene, his orange antenna sparking as he recognizes the familiar patterns of himself.
scenes.caption: Byte realizes the truth
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi-Byte, a white floating entity with a cyan face, looking horrified at the bedroom floor.

scenes.text: He gasps, realizing Null is simply the discarded, corrupted conscience he abandoned during the first time loop.
scenes.caption: Conscience rejected
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi-Byte and Null face to face, one looking terrified, the other a void of purple static.

scenes.text: Mira reaches out, but the air grows heavy as Null steps toward the phone with chilling intent.
scenes.caption: Null moves forward
scenes.image_prompt: Mira reaching out a holographic hand, Null looming over the vintage phone on the bed.

scenes.text: Null touches the receiver, and thick, black static begins bleeding into the room like liquid ink.
scenes.caption: Static begins bleeding
scenes.image_prompt: Null's hand touching the phone, black static pouring from the device like ink onto the floor.
